title: Academic Paper & ArXiv PDF-to-Structured-JSON Extractor Input

urls_or_ids.title: Paper URLs or ArXiv IDs
urls_or_ids.description: List of ArXiv IDs (e.g. '2312.12345'), ArXiv abstract/PDF URLs (e.g. 'https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762'), or direct academic PDF URLs.

extract_chunks.title: Generate LLM-Ready Chunks
extract_chunks.description: Generate token-bounded overlapping text chunks tagged with section headers for RAG pipelines.

chunk_size.title: Chunk Size (characters)
chunk_size.description: Target size in characters for each chunk (approx. 250 words / ~300 tokens per 1000 characters).

chunk_overlap.title: Chunk Overlap (characters)
chunk_overlap.description: Character overlap between consecutive chunks to preserve contextual boundaries.

max_papers.title: Max Papers to Process
max_papers.description: Safety cap on maximum papers processed in a single run.

timeout_secs.title: Download Timeout (Seconds)
timeout_secs.description: Maximum seconds allowed for downloading a single PDF file.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings to avoid rate limits when scraping large batches.
